messages:
Rohit: launching a small A/B pilot for the new price-sheet next week. 5% of paying customers globally, but enterprise tier gets special grandfathering rules. Need ops + legal + finance checklist. blockers?
Maya: whats the exact grandfathering rule? is it time-based or credit-balance based? also need to lock refund policy for any overcharge in pilot.
Rohit: grandfathering = preserve existing effective per-token rate until credits exhausted, then migrate. Delta protections for enterprises: max monthly delta cap = $250 or 10% (whichever smaller). refunds auto-detect in shadow runs.
Elena: I'll run simulated invoices and do a reconciliation pass. need the cohort export and legacy_credit balances. SQL Im using:
```
SELECT org_id, plan_id, legacy_credit_amount, billing_provider, region FROM finance.customers WHERE active=true AND paying=true ORDER BY ARR DESC LIMIT 2000
```
Tom: vendor concern: our billing vendor expects plan mapping file and webhook schema test. Can we do webhook smoke tests so vendor can validate invoice creation events?
Rohit: yes. plan mapping key: legacy_plan_id,new_plan_id,grandfather_until,cap_usd. I'll upload CSV to FIN-1499.
billing-bot: Ticket FIN-1499 created: "price-sheet-ab-pilot-webhook-smoke"  assignees: Elena, Tom. https://tickets.redwood/FIN-1499
Maya: smoke test curl (webhook) example for vendor: 
```
curl -X POST https://hooks.vendor.example/invoice -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"event":"invoice.created","invoice_id":"sim-123","amount":1234}'
```
Elena: ran initial sim: 150 orgs sampled, 6 show >10% invoice delta, 1 enterprise exceeds $250 cap. proposing exclude that org (org-778) from pilot and add manual review.
Aaron (CFO): need visibility on revenue impact projection for full rollout. please attach simulated monthly delta and expected unit economics change for 30/60/90 day windows.
Rohit: will attach projection to FIN-1499 by EOD. asking product to confirm UI strings for rate-change notices to customers in cohort.
Tom: support/CS ops: can we send simulated customer-facing emails in B cohort only? that helps verify message flows. also need an internal override flag to opt-out orgs on-demand.
Maya: gating checklist draft: 1) cohort export + legacy credit reconcile 2) webhook smoke tests green 3) top-50 invoice parity checked 4) enterprise cap enforcement in code 5) automated rollback trigger defined 6) CFO + legal sign-off
Elena: automated rollback trigger: if any org shows delta > $1000 OR >25% or if >2% of sample orgs show >10% delta, pause rollout. will implement watch job to hit #incidents.
billing-bot: FIN-1499 updated: sim-results.csv uploaded, exclude-list.txt added.
Rohit: timeline proposal: start Mon 00:00 PST, run 72h shadow + sim invoices, review Tue afternoon, extend if no issues.
Aaron (CFO): approve pilot under those caps and monitoring. require daily summary to execs during pilot.
Maya: reminder: legal wants retention of all trial invoice artifacts for 180 days and export of audit trail if any dispute arises.
Tom: i'll coordinate vendor window and confirm webhook retries/backfills for delayed events.
Elena: pushing final cohort + exclude list to FIN-1499 now. will post the reconciliation script and sim-invoice samples in the ticket.
Rohit: thanks all. final preflight sync Fri 08:00 PST. :calendar:
